title: A schema migration and its version bump commit or roll back together
statement: StorageBackend._run_migrations runs each pending migration's SQL and its PRAGMA user_version bump in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT script and rolls back on any failure, so a migration that fails partway leaves neither its earlier statements nor a version bump behind and the next start retries it cleanly.
failure_mode: executescript runs in autocommit mode, so when a multi-statement migration (v7, v8 and v10 add several columns each) failed on a later statement the earlier ALTERs stayed applied while user_version was not bumped; every following start re-ran the migration and failed on duplicate column, so the database could not be opened again without manual repair. The storage tests only migrated successfully, so a partial failure was never exercised; the deciding test now fails a migration midway and retries it.
